summary: Explored two axes at fixed architecture: (1) model depth/width via DEPTH (6, 8, 10) under the fixed 5-min budget, finding DEPTH=8 (baseline) is a local optimum -- DEPTH=6 gave 1.041227 (less capacity outweighs more steps) and DEPTH=10 gave 1.001088 (fewer steps outweighs more capacity); (2) Muon matrix learning rate (0.055, 0.06, 0.07) at DEPTH=8, finding MATRIX_LR=0.055 gives the best result (0.995760 vs baseline 0.997333), with 0.06 (0.996579) and 0.07 (0.997892) both worse, showing a fairly sharp optimum near 0.055. A quick EMBEDDING_LR bump (0.6->0.8) at the best MATRIX_LR was neutral-to-slightly-worse (0.996555), so left at default. Net improvement over baseline is small (~0.15%) and each config was only run once, so it should be treated as a weak signal; next steps would be to confirm MATRIX_LR=0.055 is robust with a second seed, then explore weight-decay schedule or warmdown ratio jointly with the tuned Muon LR, which was not attempted here due to the 6-run budget.
